description: This file defines the UsbAccess class, which is a plugin component for managing USB devices within the WPEFramework. It includes method declarations for USB operations like retrieving file lists, creating/deleting links, firmware management, and event handling related to USB mount changes. The file also contains static constants for method names, event types, and internal data structures.

classes.name: UsbAccess
classes.description: Represents a USB access plugin for WPEFramework, providing methods for managing USB device interactions, firmware operations, and event handling within the plugin ecosystem.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the given shell service.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the plugin, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: getFileListWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper method to get list of files at a specified path.

methods.name: createLinkWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper method to create a link to a USB device or resource.

methods.name: clearLinkWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper method to remove a link.

methods.name: getLinksWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper method to retrieve existing links.

methods.name: getAvailableFirmwareFilesWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper method to list available firmware files.

methods.name: getMountedWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper method to list mounted USB devices.

methods.name: updateFirmware
methods.description: Wrapper method to update firmware on a device.

methods.name: archiveLogs
methods.description: Wrapper method to archive logs from USB devices.

methods.name: eventHandler
methods.description: Static callback for handling IARM events.

methods.name: onUSBMountChanged
methods.description: Handles an event when a USB device's mount status changes.

methods.name: archiveLogsInternal
methods.description: Starts internal process to archive logs.

methods.name: onArchiveLogs
methods.description: Handles completion or errors of log archiving.
